## stackoverflow.com

### Base 64 Regex

https://stackoverflow.com/a/35002237/200348

Original code:
```js
var base64regex = /^([0-9a-zA-Z+/]{4})*(([0-9a-zA-Z+/]{2}==)|([0-9a-zA-Z+/]{3}=))?$/;
```

Modified to be:
```js
const BASE64_STRING_REGEX = /^([0-9a-zA-Z+/]{4})*(([0-9a-zA-Z+/]{2}==)|([0-9a-zA-Z+/]{3}=))?$/;
```
